summary: @servicetitan/admin-layout preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated bundle (hex-named identifiers, rotated string/opcode array, custom-alphabet string decoder) with no source form, no documented purpose, and a filename unrelated to the package's advertised React admin-layout function. Running an alternate language runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload at install time is a dropper pattern that evades scanners inspecting only Node-resolved code. The package uses the @servicetitan/* scope and declares peer dependencies on multiple @servicetitan/* internal packages while shipping empty description/author/repository/homepage metadata, consistent with a dependency-confusion upload targeting installers of ServiceTitan internal tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
